body: Merged main through the stack (#516 → #517 → #518 → #468); it merges cleanly now. #516's one conflict was in `ChangeOperationKind`: main's per-setup `family_gate` and this stack's `thread_gate` are both kept. The threading, lathe-post, conformance, posting and project_roundtrip suites pass on each branch, as do all camcraft-post tests; clippy is clean. Still a draft until a lathe run.

Merged #517's refreshed branch to resolve conflicts. It carries #516's rebuild on #629's ladder, plus main.

- **`cnc_thread.rs`:** `HAND`, `ALT 1` and this PR's `REP 1` are all kept, so the line is `... PULLOUT .. HAND .. [ALT 1] [REP 1]`.
- **`CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md`:** documents all three.
- **`inverted_post`:** its literal keeps both fields.

Gate:
- app: lib 103, `conformance` 6, `golden_cl` 23, `inverted_post` 15, `lathe_post` 7, `lathe_post_g76` 8, `lathe_post_g76_schedule` 5, `lathe_post_refusals` 5, `posting` 17, `project_roundtrip` 71, `turning_thread` 9, `turning_thread_infeed` 5.
- post and motion thread suites: green.
- clippy `-D warnings` on post and motion (all targets): clean.

Still a draft for a lathe run. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

Merged main to resolve conflicts (merged #517's refreshed branch, which carries main with #712; crates/app/tests/lathe_thread_travel.rs: keep both sides). Targeted gate: app lathe_thread_travel 2, lathe_post_g76, lathe_post_g76_schedule, turning_thread_infeed pass; clippy -D warnings clean on camcraft-app. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check). Stays a draft.

Merged main to resolve conflicts (stacked on #517: merged its refreshed branch, which carries #516's and main's changes; no textual conflicts remained). Targeted gate: app lathe_post_g76 8, lathe_post_g76_schedule 5, turning_thread_infeed 5, inverted_post 15; motion turning_thread_cycle 3, turning_thread_infeed 10 pass; clippy -D warnings clean (motion, app lib). Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

Merge-time refresh of this PR against main (46) was tried and not pushed. The merge itself resolves cleanly: three conflicts (operation/create.rs and edit.rs: thread_gate kept beside main's sinker_gate / tool_door / wire_gate; post/tests/inverted_post.rs: main moved the file to crates/post/tests, both sides' ThreadCycle fields kept), plus four test literals main added since (post recorded_streams, app tormach_lathe_support, coarse_laws, lathe_post_css) that need the new thread infeed fields. Everything builds and these pass: motion turning_thread_infeed 10/10, turning_thread_cycle, turning_thread; app lathe_post_g76_schedule, lathe_post_g76, turning_thread, lathe_thread_travel, lathe_field_tools, coarse_laws, lathe_post_css, lathe_post_tormach; post inverted_post, recorded_streams.

One pinning test fails after the merge: app turning_thread_infeed, the_plan_rides_the_project_file_and_a_default_one_is_absent, at the assertion 'TH1: the loaded cache matches its plan' (left Stale, right Ok). TH1 reads Stale after a project load with the reason "operation 'TH0' ahead of it in the program changed - regenerate the program in order" (rest.rs prior_stale). It still fails when TH1 is given the default plan, so it is not the repeat/infeed logic: a second turning op after a first one goes Stale on reload on current main (main touched operation/stamp.rs, stamp_tool.rs and rest/carried_cache.rs, #637 field engine key). Please look at whether the test's expectation or the reload of a chained lathe program needs changing, resolve it on the branch, and ask for a re-check. Nothing was pushed; the branch is unchanged at 5a6fc6f7.

Follow-up on the earlier refresh stop: the failing test `turning_thread_infeed.rs::the_plan_rides_the_project_file_and_a_default_one_is_absent` was not this PR's fault. It was a defect on main (issue 1351: a second dependent threading operation read Stale after save and load, because the path signature hashed bit-exact values while the project file snaps them to its lattice). PR 1352 fixed it on main (merge commit 0ad525d8). After the next merge of main the test should pass. This PR changes the Passes tab; before/after screenshots in the description help the maintainer merge UI changes.

Taken for the refresh (SKULL, mkinney fork agent): merging main into #516 -> #517 and #518 -> #468, bottom-up, now that #1351/#1352 is on main. Other sessions: please leave this PR alone until SKULL's follow-up comment.

Refreshed on main (author side, not a review) - ready for review.

Head `5e9909cc` (three commits on `5a6fc6f7`):
1. `dc962cc9` - merge of upstream/main `36035af8`.
2. `872cc40d` - test-only: this stack's new fields at main's new literals (`infeed_plan: Default::default()` in `coarse_laws.rs`, `lathe_post_css.rs`, `tormach_lathe_support/mod.rs` - the same lines #516 carries; `alternating`/`repeat_each_depth: false` in `crates/post/tests/recorded_streams.rs`).
3. `5e9909cc` - merge of the refreshed #517 head (`31946250`).

GitHub reports this MERGEABLE with today's newer main (`ebaceb1c`, 78 commits past the one merged here).

**Conflicts and resolutions**
- `commands/operation/create.rs`, `edit.rs`, `gates.rs`: same as #516. Main's #894 thread-mill `thread_gate`, #546 `named_refusal` and the sinker/tool_door/wire gates all stay. This stack's lathe infeed-plan door is renamed `infeed_plan_gate` so it no longer collides with main's `thread_gate`. The three files are taken from #516's resolution (`4d806580`); this branch's own change to them was identical to #416's. No refusal is dropped.
- `tests/inverted_post.rs` moved to `crates/post/tests` on main (`camcraft_post` paths). This branch's `alternating`/`repeat_each_depth` ThreadRec fields are kept in the moved file.
- **Why #517 was merged in (a decision, recorded here):** this branch carried an older #417 head. Once main's #612 Tormach lathe post arrived, it refused any non-zero FinishAllowance, so five `lathe_post_tormach_thread` tests went red ("LinuxCNC's G76 has no finish-pass allowance word"). Under #417 that field is the finishing pass's own step. The parent already fixes this in `548a4ad2` ("the PathPilot G76 reads the finishing step #417 states"). Rather than re-derive that post logic by hand, I merged the parent's refreshed head. That merge brings `assets/posts/tormach-lathe.cps`, the `lathe_post_tormach_thread`/`turning_thread_infeed` pins and the #417 decision note into this diff, the same as #517's. Its only conflicts were the two test literals (both fields kept, one `alternating`). As a result, this PR now contains #517's current head, so the stack is #516 -> #517 -> #518 as its description says.
- `git diff upstream/main --stat`: only this PR's and its parents' (#516, #517) files.

**Posted output:** nothing changes from the merges. This stack's golden edits (`fanuc-lathe/thread_g76.nc`, `fanuc-lathe/thread_g76_area.nc`) are byte-identical to the previous head, and main's goldens are untouched (checked against `36035af8`). The Tormach G76 output is #517's (its `.nc` goldens are byte-identical to the 8L-sim-run files, per the Hub record on #516/#517).

**Tests (final head, no edits during the run)**
- `turning_thread_infeed::the_plan_rides_the_project_file_and_a_default_one_is_absent` passes (main's #1352).
- app `turning_thread*`, all `lathe_*` (incl. `lathe_post_g76_schedule`, `lathe_post_tormach_thread`), `tormach_lathes`, `golden_cl`, `operations`, `project_roundtrip`; post `lathe_post_refusals`, `script_fanuc_lathe`, `script_tormach_lathe`; motion `turning_thread*` + lib `turning`; ui lib `thread`: all green.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: `crates/cl` is touched, so quick falls back to **batch**. Steps 01-06 (geometry, cl, tools, post, sim, motion) were green. The run hit its 30-min cap in step 07, so steps 07-09 (app suites, ui suites, clippy `-D warnings` on all eight crates) were re-run with the batch plan's exact commands: all green.

Screenshots of the Passes tab (before/after) are in the description. Flagged ready.

Back to draft (SKULL, author side): during the refresh this PR took the refreshed #517 (31946250) to get #517's PathPilot G76 finishing-step fix (548a4ad2), which main's #612 Tormach lathe post made necessary. It now carries #516's and #517's content, and both stay draft for the Fanuc-lathe check. Merging #518 alone would land them unchecked. So #518 is stacked on #517 (merge order #516 -> #517 -> #518) and goes ready once those two clear. The code and tests are unchanged from the refresh comment above.
SKULL: parked behind #517 (stacked: merge order #516 ✓ → #517 → #518). #517 waits on the Fanuc-lathe check. Once #517 merges, this branch takes main, is re-gated and is flagged ready.

Merged main into the branch (head 2ed50b9a4). One conflict, crates/app/src/project/thread_dto.rs: main's ThreadPassesDto block was taken whole (it carries the is_false helper both sides had added). cargo check of app tests clean; lathe_post_g76, lathe_post_g76_schedule and turning_thread_infeed pass. No review marker stood for the old head, so this needs a review of the current head.
